=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:812-823 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `DriftRepairer._managed_names` only discards `ai-update-workflows.yml` and never adds it when the consumer has it, so a drifted updater on a core or standard profile consumer is not repaired.
  WHY: The restore PR leaves the updater drifted, so its own `coding-workflows/workflow-integrity` status fails and it cannot merge. Severity is MAJOR in all five reports.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:903-913 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The restore-branch ownership check trusts a commit author email and subject prefix that anyone with push access can forge, and a `--force-with-lease` push follows.
  WHY: A forged tip is accepted as the audit's own and force-pushed over, and the lease protects only against concurrent updates. Severity disagreement: BLOCKER (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite), MAJOR (openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus), NIT (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, which calls it a best-effort guard). The highest, BLOCKER, is mapped to critical.
- .github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:182-277 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The alert level considers only `drift_results` and `error_results`, so a `match` consumer whose repair opens a PR or fails stays at DEBUG, and the DEBUG body says all wrappers match.
  WHY: At the default `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=WARNING` no Telegram alert is sent, so stuck or failing repairs go unnoticed.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:1003-1007 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The comment, and `changelog.d/8066-managed-wrapper-integrity.md:18` and `agents.d/8066-managed-wrapper-integrity.md:3`, say `diff --ignore-space-at-eol` is a git-only flag that makes GNU diff exit 2. Four reviewers call this false. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked it and found the claim accurate.
  WHY: If the claim is false, it misleads maintainers, because the same flag is still used at lines 667 and 776. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (qwen_qwen3_7-plus), NIT (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, whose NIT entry says the claim is accurate). The highest, MAJOR, is mapped to high.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:852-963 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The repair path clones every drifted and matching consumer each day even though the audit already fetched the wrapper bytes.
  WHY: It adds clone time against the 30-minute job timeout. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite), NIT (the other three). The highest, MAJOR, is mapped to high.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:858-866 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The repair checks only the leaf wrapper path for a symlink, so a symlinked `.github` or `.github/workflows` in a consumer clone redirects the write outside the clone.
  WHY: A tampered consumer repo can make the daily cron write files outside the clone on the runner that holds `GH_PAT`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Consumer repos can no longer change the managed workflow wrappers." The README says each consumer default branch carries a ruleset that requires `coding-workflows/workflow-integrity`.
  expected_change_site: Consumer default-branch ruleset provisioning or verification (a poller or sync step), or another mechanism that requires the `coding-workflows/workflow-integrity` status.
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk installs or verifies the ruleset, README.md:1335-1345 and `agents.d/8066-managed-wrapper-integrity.md` say it is applied by hand after a release, and without it the status is advisory. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash treats this as a documented manual deferral, not a gap. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rates it NIT and notes the editor already ignored it as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- (TASK_GAP) Requirement: "Consumer repos can no longer change the managed workflow wrappers." | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Expected change site: automation that installs or checks the ruleset, or a poller or sync step that reports a consumer default branch lacking it.
  Evidence of absence: No diff hunk applies or verifies the ruleset. The README and `agents.d/8066-managed-wrapper-integrity.md` say it is applied by hand after a release.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:`DriftRepairer._repair` restore-branch ownership check | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The ownership check relies on a forgeable commit author email and subject.
  WHY: Only someone who can already push and who deliberately names a branch `auto/restore-managed-workflows` can trigger it. The damage is limited to overwriting that branch.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:817-823 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_managed_names` only discards the updater and never adds it, so a drifted updater on a core or standard consumer is not repaired.
  WHY: The restore PR's own integrity status still fails, so it cannot merge.
- .github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:182 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The alert level ignores repair outcomes for `match` repositories.
  WHY: A stuck or failing repair is never alerted at the default `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=WARNING`.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:1004-1007 | severity=NIT | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: Another reviewer called the "git-only flag" claim wrong. This reviewer checked it and found the comment accurate. The same invocation at :667 and :776 is harmless and not introduced by this PR, so it is not reported.
  WHY: No defect found.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:`DriftRepairer._repair` (depth-1 clone) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Every consumer is cloned each day even when the wrapper bytes were already fetched.
  WHY: The cost is small and no timeout risk is demonstrated.
- HARDENING: `_managed_names` should add `UPDATER_WRAPPER` when the local file exists (about 2 lines). The `level` computation should account for repair outcomes and list `repairs` in the DEBUG body (about 4 lines). `_repair` should skip a repository whose `.github` or `.github/workflows` is a symlink (about 4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:903-906, 911-913 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The restore-branch ownership check trusts a forgeable commit author email and subject prefix, and a force-with-lease push follows.
  WHY: An attacker with push access can forge the identity and force-push over an existing restore branch.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:812-823 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_managed_names` only discards `ai-update-workflows.yml` and never adds it to the repair set.
  WHY: The restore PR will not repair the drifted updater, so its integrity status keeps failing and it cannot merge.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:852, 963 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The daily audit performs a full clone of every consumer repository, and raw byte comparisons are not cached effectively.
  WHY: Cloning many repositories daily can exhaust the 30-minute job timeout.
- .github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:182, 234-246, 275-277 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Repairs for `match` consumers leave the Telegram report level at DEBUG, omitting details from the main alert.
  WHY: A failed or opened repair for a `match` consumer is not notified, leading to silent failures.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:1003, changelog.d/8066-managed-wrapper-integrity.md:18, agents.d/8066-managed-wrapper-integrity.md:3 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Documentation wrongly claims `diff --ignore-space-at-eol` is not a GNU diff option.
  WHY: It misdirects future maintainers, as the option is valid and still used elsewhere in the workflow.
- (TASK_GAP) Requirement: "Consumer repos can no longer change the managed workflow wrappers." | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Expected change site: Consumer default-branch ruleset provisioning or another mechanism that requires the `coding-workflows/workflow-integrity` status.
  Evidence of absence: The diff adds the integrity status check but no code that installs or verifies a required-status ruleset, and README.md:1335-1345 describes applying the ruleset manually.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:903-906, 911-913 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The restore-branch ownership check trusts the commit author email and subject, both of which a pusher can set.
  WHY: A contributor can forge them so the audit accepts the tip and force-pushes over the contributor's work.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:812-823 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_managed_names` does not add `ai-update-workflows.yml` when the consumer has it but its profile does not list it.
  WHY: The integrity checker treats the updater as managed whenever either tree has it (`.github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:283-288`), so the restore PR leaves the integrity check failing.
- .github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:180-182, 213-246, 275-278 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The alert level is based on `drift` and `error` results, not on repair outcomes, so a `match` consumer's repair leaves the level at DEBUG and the message says all wrappers match.
  WHY: A restore PR or repair failure for a match-only consumer is not reported at the default `WARNING` threshold.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:1003-1006 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The comment says `diff --ignore-space-at-eol` is a git-only option that makes GNU diff exit 2.
  WHY: GNU diff supports the option, and the workflow still uses it at lines 667 and 776.
- (TASK_GAP) Requirement: "Consumer repos can no longer change the managed workflow wrappers." | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Expected change site: Consumer default-branch ruleset provisioning or another mechanism that makes `coding-workflows/workflow-integrity` a required check.
  Evidence of absence: The PR adds a status-producing integrity workflow but no code provisions or verifies required-status enforcement, and README.md:1335-1345 says to apply the ruleset manually.
- HARDENING: scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:858-865. The leaf symlink check does not reject symlinked `.github` or `.github/workflows` parents. Verify both are real directories before the repair loop (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
